body:
## Goal

Fix the guest-name signature overlapping the episode title on the EP05 carousel card by applying a small per-episode title letter-spacing override, so the word "verification" reflows up onto the first title line and the clamped title no longer fills both lines under the absolutely-positioned `.episode-guest` signature.

This is an alternative approach to the backdrop fix tracked in #78, requested by @lolipopshock as a separate stacked PR for side-by-side preview comparison.

## Context

The overlap was diagnosed on [PR #77](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/77): in [`EpisodeCarousel.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx), `.card-title` (`<h4>`) is `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` and EP05's long title — "It's Our Mathematics: AI, Verification, and the Future of Math with Jeremy Avigad" — fills both clamped lines, running under the floating handwritten guest signature (`.episode-guest`, `position: absolute; bottom`). EP05 is the only episode with a title long enough to fill 2 full lines.

The component already supports a per-episode `guestOffset` frontmatter knob (read at [EpisodeCarousel.tsx:60](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L60)); this task adds a similar per-episode knob for card-title letter-spacing.

## Approach

- Add an optional per-episode frontmatter field (e.g. `titleLetterSpacing`) read in `EpisodeCarousel.tsx` and applied as an inline `letter-spacing` style on the `.card-title` `<h4>` (mirroring how `guestOffset` is applied to `.episode-guest`). When unset, render no override so all other cards are unaffected.
- Set a small negative value (e.g. `-0.02em`, tuned to taste) in [`content/episodes/ep05.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/episodes/ep05.md) frontmatter so "verification" tucks onto the first line and the title fits without overlapping the guest signature.
- Keep the change scoped to EP05 frontmatter plus the minimal component/SCSS plumbing for the new knob.

## Sequencing / preview

- Open this as a **stacked PR based on the EP5 branch** (`agent/implement-issue-75/claude-27244386885`, the head of PR #77), NOT `main`, so the surge.sh per-PR deploy preview renders EP05 together with the fix — the only way to verify the long-title card.
- After EP05 (#77) merges to `main`, retarget/rebase this fix onto `main`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] EP05 carousel card title no longer overlaps the guest signature; "verification" sits on the first title line.
- [ ] Guest signature is legible on the EP05 card at desktop (300px) and mobile (260px/240px) widths.
- [ ] No visual regression on ep02–ep04 cards (override is opt-in per episode).
- [ ] Change scoped to a per-episode title letter-spacing knob plus the EP05 frontmatter value.
- [ ] PR opened against the EP5 branch so the surge.sh preview shows both changes together.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/77

**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-81/claude-27251430191`
- Pull request: https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/82

Added an opt-in per-episode `titleLetterSpacing` frontmatter knob to EpisodeCarousel.tsx, applied as an inline `letter-spacing` style on the `.card-title` <h4> only when set (mirroring the existing `guestOffset` pattern, so all other cards are untouched). Set `titleLetterSpacing: "-0.02em"` in content/episodes/ep05.md so the long EP05 title tightens slightly and 'Verification' reflows onto the first line, clearing the 2-line clamp that ran under the floating guest signature. Typecheck via `tsc` could not run as a meaningful check because node_modules is not installed in this environment (all errors are missing-module/JSX-runtime, unrelated to the edit); the change is a 6-line addition matching an established pattern, verified by diff review.
